subject: Virtual onsite for Cam Nguyen — circuit slate & debrief owners
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Virtual onsite for Cam Nguyen — circuit slate & debrief owners

Hi team,

We have Cam Nguyen's full loop penciled for next Wednesday (2026-07-21). Cam is a senior infra candidate (site reliability / LLM infra), and recruiting asked for a compact, 4-slot virtual onsite with a short async buffer between slots to allow micro-debriefs. Draft slate below — please confirm availability or propose a swap.

Proposed sequence (PST):
- 09:30–10:10 — Systems deep dive (Karthik) — 40m + 10m quick notes
- 10:20–11:00 — Production ML infra / deployment (Laura) — 35m + 5m notes
- 11:15–11:55 — Service design & incidents (Logan) — 35m + 5m notes
- 12:10–12:50 — Leadership / cross-functional (Tessa) — 35m + 5m notes

Can we use the 10m windows between blocks for immediate scribe notes (quick markups, not full feedback) and then a 30-minute debrief at 14:00 for the panel owners? I suggest Karthik own the technical scorecard, Laura own the system reliability rubric, and I will own the hire/no-hire synthesis for the hiring committee.

Attachments: Cam_Nguyen_Resume.pdf (educational background), fullloop-prep-packet.pdf (candidate packet).

If anyone has a hard conflict, call it out now — we’ll add a backup. Otherwise I’ll ask Marissa to push invites and the debrief calendar.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite for Cam Nguyen — circuit slate & debrief owners

On Tue, Jul 14, 2026 at 09:12 AM Tessa Morgan wrote:
> We have Cam Nguyen's full loop penciled for next Wednesday...

Thanks, Tessa — the slot looks fine. One request: could we swap my block to 09:15–09:55 and shift the rest earlier by 15m? I have an upstream customer sync at 10:30 that I can’t move. If shifting is hard, I can still make the 09:30 but prefer the earlier start.

Also: I’ll own the technical scorecard but can’t be on the 14:00 debrief start — can we make the panel debrief 14:30 so I can join after my overlap? If that’s a blocker, Laura or Logan can lead the first 15m and I’ll join for the synthesis.

Karthik
Staff Engineer

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite for Cam Nguyen — circuit slate & debrief owners

Folks — I can make a 15m shift. Updated schedule below (PST) with the 15m earlier start Karthik requested, and I've built in 12m buffers to give Cam a moment between sessions:

- 09:15–09:55 — Systems deep dive (Karthik) — Zoom A
- 10:07–10:47 — Production ML infra (Laura) — Zoom B
- 11:02–11:42 — Service design & incidents (Logan) — Zoom C
- 11:57–12:37 — Leadership / cross-functional (Tessa) — Zoom A

Final panel debrief: 14:30–15:00 (Zoom D) — please add to calendar. I’ve reserved Logan as the primary for the incident slot and added Irene Choi as a shadow for any late swap; if Karthik needs to drop the debrief lead at the start, Laura will run the first 10 minutes.

Invites: I will send the calendar invites and include the fullloop-prep-packet link and the debrief-scorecard-template.xlsx as attachments.

Related links: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=virtual-onsite-cam-nguyen

Marissa
Senior Recruiter, Talent Acquisition

(Attachment stubs: fullloop-prep-packet.pdf, debrief-scorecard-template.xlsx)
From: Cam Nguyen <cam.nguyen@gmail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite for Cam Nguyen — circuit slate & debrief owners

Hi Marissa/Tessa,

Thanks — the timeline works for me. I prefer 09:15 PST (it's morning here) and appreciate the short breaks — they help. A couple quick Qs:

1) Will you share a single Zoom link for all sessions or separate links per interviewer?
2) Do you expect any pre-interview short test or whiteboard? I can prepare a short design doc if helpful.

Attached is my updated resume (Cam_Nguyen_Resume.pdf).

Best,
Cam

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Cam Nguyen <cam.nguyen@gmail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite for Cam Nguyen — circuit slate & debrief owners

Thanks Cam — we’ll use separate Zoom links per session (Zoom A/B/C) to keep meeting rooms small; Marissa will paste all links into the invites. No formal pre-test — if you’d like to bring a short design doc that’s welcome but not required.

Quick operational notes for the panel:
- Karthik: you own the technical scorecard and please add 2–3 signal checks (latency/scale incident story + KV caching at scale).
- Laura: you own system reliability rubric and log ingestion / rollout questions.
- Logan: you lead incident scenarios and note escalation handling.
- Irene: standby as shadow and will take notes if someone needs to drop.
- I will write the synthesis and escalate any calibration items to hiring committee.

Marissa — please attach debrief-scorecard-template.xlsx to the 14:30 invite and add the fullloop-prep-packet as a comment in each interviewer invite. Also confirm Zoom room names (A/B/C/D) in the calendar.

Appreciate the quick turn — see you all next week.

Tessa
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
